text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho drags me to the zoo. I ask
her if
there's an animal she wants to see,
and she says...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm looking for the strongest familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You bet! I'm looking for the ultimate familiar that's got it all! Strength, intelligence, and a soft coat to boot!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The zoo's having a reopening and there's
way
more animals now! It's the perfect
place to look!
Now, hurry up and let's
go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wow! It's so fluffy! Alpaca, you might
not be
strong but you sure do feel
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All right, you're gonna be my familiar!
Then, I'll
use magic to knit some fluffy
towels and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Alpaca
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait! Why are you running away?!
Waaait!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, look at that kangaroo! It's so buff!
It must
be super strong!

text_block_list.name: Kangaroo
text_block_list.text: Boing! Boing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I bet it's trying to tell me that it's the
strongest
familiar... It's showing off how
strong it is!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All right! Since you're my oldest familiar,
I want
you to box it! Let's go! ♪

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Sign-ups for the owl meet and greet are
now
closed!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! But I wanna go! I want an owl to
deliver my
mail!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar! No one can hear you if you talk
like that!
Get your butt over there and
speak up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Sweep Tosho continues to
drag me all
over the zoo...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm thirsty and my legs hurt! This place is
too big!
We still haven't even seen all
the potential
familiars.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for visiting today. Please be
aware
that the zoo will be closing soon.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What?! It's closing already?! We've gotta
hurry
up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho expresses her exhaustion
and
discontent. If I know her, the next
thing out of her
mouth will be...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Are you kidding me?! No! No, no, NO! I'm not leaving till I have my new familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
We've been running around all day! And
now I'm
supposed to just go home with
nothing to show
for it but exhaustion?!
Forget that! No waaay!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yeah! This was so much fun, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But how could a genius magical girl like
me forget
to cast a time extension spell?
Really!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I need to be more careful next time,
because the
time just flew by!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I got to meet so many potential familiars!
Just
thinking about all the magic I could
teach them
has got me really excited!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I really thought she was going to throw a
tantrum,
but it looks like Sweep Tosho is
thoroughly
satisfied with the day!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna be so great when we finally
scout the
strongest possible familiar!
Hehe, I can't
waaait! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's gonna be so great when we finally
scout the
strongest possible familiar!
Hehe, I can't
waaait! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh! Good thinking!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I already picked out the
stuffed animals
I want! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fluff the alpaca and Hoot the owl! Listen
up!
Thank your lucky stars because,
starting today,
you're my new familiars!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sun starts to set as we take the train
back to
campus. Seeing her smiling at
her new stuffed
animals makes me want
to create even more
happy memories for
her.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I still can't decide! None of them even
looked at
me when I spoke to them! Not
even for a second!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I need to practice my magical creature
languages
when we get back... You
ought to join me,
Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
We've got to learn to speak with lions,

kangaroos, owls... Oh! And alpacas too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Listening to her talk animatedly about
all of the
things we saw today makes me
want to create
even more happy
memories for her.
